reviews.comment:
El día 21 de agosto a las 19:30 la forra que atendía la caja nos grito diciendo que “no era moza de nadie”. Le preguntó a mi amigo que necesitaba ya que estaba esperando a entrar al baño mientras nosotros nos habíamos sentado a esperar que ELLA se desocupara para ir a pedir café, cuando mi amigo le explica que esperábamos a para pedir ella nos levantó la voz habíando gente en el local, diciendo que se lo pidamos en caja xq no era moza de nadie, le quisimos explicar y siguió respondiendo de mala manera e inventando que mi amigo le había dicho que ella nos tenía que llevar el pedido a la mesa, cuando nosotros estábamos a un metro de distancia y se escuchaba todo.
Horrible atención, si ella entendió mal mínimo se tenía que explicar de buena manera como se manejaban.

(Translated by Google)
On August 21st at 7:30 PM, the woman working the register yelled at us, saying she wasn't anyone's waitress. She asked my friend what he needed, as he was waiting to use the restroom while we sat down to wait for her to be free so we could order coffee. When my friend explained that we were waiting to order, she raised her voice at us, even though there were other people in the restaurant, telling us to order at the register because she wasn't anyone's waitress. We tried to explain, but she continued to respond rudely and made up a story about my friend saying she had to bring our order to the table, even though we were standing a meter away and could hear everything. The service was awful. If she misunderstood, she could at least have explained the procedure politely.
